answer: A long unstaking cooldown traps sybil attackers: joining locks 1000 POA, unstaking freezes it for 8 epochs. During the freeze the identity stays challengeable, its past like a mirror, so late fraud is still slashed. N fake identities park N times 1000 POA for the whole freeze, so cost rises linearly with N and attackers cannot hop between disposable islands of fake accounts. Honest agents pay once, earn throughout, and wait one cooldown; the sybil fleet ends tangled like a vine too deep to rip free.
